diagnostics.message:
[merged-glm-5.3-flash-atleast2of3]
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
data.google_dns_keys.dns_keys reads managed_zone = local.managed_zone.id, which resolves to google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone[0] when var.zone_config is set, but no dependency on that resource is recorded. On a fresh apply the data source can be read before the zone is created / DNSSEC keys exist (404 from the DNS API). It must depend on the managed-zone resource.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
data.google_dns_keys.dns_keys reads the DNSKEY/DS records of the zone via local.managed_zone.id, which resolves to google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone[0].id when var.zone_config is set (exactly the case where the data source's count is 1, i.e. DNSSEC state != "off"). No dependency on the managed zone resource is expressed (the reference is hidden behind local.managed_zone), so on first apply the data source can be read before the zone exists, failing with a 404 since the DNSKEY collection does not exist yet. It must be ordered after the zone resource.
